feature: Marketing rebuild Part 9 -- /pricing (Design/design_handoff_marketing/Marketing Pricing.dc.html). The full price architecture on one page -- ladder card, four 'doors', ongoing-customer tiers, funnel steps. Every number is pulled from the same live sources /monitoring, /retainers and /quick-start already read (useCatalog() monitoring tiers, useServices('retainer') + resolvePublicServicePriceCents, the quickStartPacks.ts fixture), not retyped as a fourth independent literal.
notes: Public marketing page, no auth required.

REAL INCONSISTENCY FOUND AND RESOLVED: the design mock's own retainer ladder/ongoing-tiers list a fourth, fictional 'Advisory' tier at $900/mo (5 hours) and price the retainer range as '$900-$5,500/mo'. Per Retainers.tsx's own documented pricing correction (and retainers-page.json's live 11/11 run), the live catalog (service_type='retainer') has only THREE fixed-hour tiers: Architect Essentials $1,500/mo (8h), Growth $3,000/mo (16h), Enterprise $5,500/mo (30h) -- no Advisory row exists. This page reads those same three tiers live (isFixedHourlyRetainer filter, resolvePublicServicePriceCents) instead of copying the mock's numbers, so the ladder/doors correctly show '$1,500-$5,500/mo' and 'From $1,500/mo', never the mock's fictional $900 figure.

Monitoring's 'from $180/mo' figure and the Quick-Start '$149-$799' range in the mock both verified correct against the live sources /monitoring and /quick-start already read (Foundation tier's pricePerUserMonth $12 x seatCountFloor 15 = $180 min; PACKS fixture min/max $149/$799) -- computed live/derived from the same fixture below rather than retyped, so this page can never drift from those two pages even if the catalog changes.
PR1/PR2/PR3 extract the real retainer tier names+priceCents the same way retainers-page.json does, confirming there are exactly 3 fixed-hour rows (not 4) backing this page's ladder/doors range.
This manifest asserts against {{DEPLOY_URL}} -- only reflects this commit once the marketing site is redeployed.
